description: Source code for the AudioShelvingFilter class, implementing audio filtering with high and low shelf filters, including configuration, reset, and coefficient calculation methods.

classes.name: AudioShelvingFilter
classes.description: Class implementing a shelving filter for audio processing, supporting high and low shelf types, with configuration and coefficient management.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the filter with the number of channels and sample rate, setting internal parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the filter to default gain and frequency settings.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the cutoff frequency of the filter in millihertz, with bounds checking.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets the gain of the filter in millibel.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Calculates filter coefficients based on current frequency and gain, applying them to the biquad filter.
